protocol.candidate_comparison: same held-out targets; globally shared MLP-channel set
protocol.kfac_selection: Sum layer-local singleton down_proj input-column KFAC costs; choose lowest sum.
protocol.magnitude_selection: Sum squared gate/up row and down column weights across layers; choose lowest L2.
limitations: Single model and one CPU run; no statistical uncertainty or family transfer.
Additive singleton costs omit channel-channel and cross-layer interactions.
No compensation or recovery is applied.
Only WikiText perplexity is measured; no task or decode tests.
KFAC costs are proxies; held-out artifact measurements are authoritative.
